expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The plant yields about 1500 kg of fresh woody stem, reduced to 300 kg of dry weight per hectare in about two years.
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.note: 300 kg dry stem per hectare over about two years = 0.03 kg/m² (not per year). It needs a host tree, stake or trellis.

source_notes: AI research batch 15 (2026-10-08), medicinal and ayurvedic crops. Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Yields are of the dried product that is sold (dried root, leaf or seed) unless a note says fresh. Sowing dates are from national guides (region india) unless a Malwa study is named. Medicinal crops are planned only when the owner picks the medicinal method; the market for each is thin and buy-back is not assured (see the economics sources).

price_mandi_paise_per_kg.title: e-CHARAK (National Medicinal Plants Board, Ministry of Ayush): average market price of the last 6 months, Rs/kg
price_mandi_paise_per_kg.note: Stem (dry), 6-month average. Rs 37.41/kg: at 300 kg dry stem per hectare over about two years this is a low-income crop, grown for the little work it takes.
